summary.en: The handset sound: the data bed in F at 112–128 BPM, its sections following the scenes, and sounds that belong to the device (a tick on each landing, a flick under a scroll, a thock on the flip).
summary.zh: handset 的声音：F 调 data 音乐床，112–128 BPM，段落跟随场景；声音属于设备（每次落定一声嘀嗒，滚动一声甩动，翻转一声闷响）。

fits: Calm launch films on one device; product demos whose motion is small and precise.
notFor: High-energy reels that need a big drop every few seconds; voice-over films (duck it instead).

intent.en: A soft steady groove under small precise sounds, so each landing on the screen is heard as a click of a real device.
intent.zh: 柔和稳定的律动托着细小精确的音效，屏幕上每次落定都像真设备的一声咔哒。

content.en: A film on the surface-tour arc; event kinds from the scenes’ plans.
content.zh: 按 surface-tour 骨架编排的片子；事件种类来自各场景的 plan。

fits.zh: 一台设备上的平静发布片；动作小而准的产品演示。

notFor.zh: 每几秒就要大高潮的快节奏混剪；有旁白的片（改为压低）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
